name: Budget calculator
description: A small calculator for quantity, unit cost and an estimated total; no database required.
whenToUse: A quick interactive multiplication or cost estimate without persistent records.
whenNotToUse: Accounting, invoicing, financial advice or a calculation requiring an authoritative pricing source.
instructions: Set heading and currency to the user’s wording. This is a local estimate, not a saved financial record. The configuration is supplied as templateConfiguration and source executes in the existing sandbox. If additional calculations are needed, adapt the returned source with prepare_app. Never claim that local form state was saved.
